effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers with a play cost of 3 or less.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] If this Digimon has the [Machine] or [Dragonkin] trait, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers with a play cost of 3 or less.
